products.name: Conditional Access Integration — Commercial
products.short_description: Make compliant devices and MFA hard requirements. Roll out Conditional Access yourself — safely, with self-guided, tested steps — for far less than consulting.
products.description:
Zero Trust access enforcement — deployed safely, lockout-free

Device compliance and MFA only protect you if access is actually gated on them. Conditional Access is the enforcement engine: it evaluates every sign-in — is the device compliant? did the user pass MFA? is this legacy authentication? — and allows, challenges, or blocks accordingly. Done wrong, it locks people out; done right, it is the backbone of Zero Trust.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant on site to deploy Conditional Access Integration. This package hands you the exact, field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation that a non-expert administrator can follow from start to finish — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell scripts that do the heavy lifting. You implement with confidence, on your own schedule, and keep the playbook forever.

  • Simpler — exact navigation in the right order, written for a novice admin. Click to implement; the “why” lives in the overview so the steps stay short and uncluttered.
  • Cheaper — one fixed, transparent price instead of an open meter. A comparable consulting engagement runs $1,500–$3,000 per day across several days; this is a fraction of that, with nothing left to bill.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with validation scripts and clear pass/fail gates, so you know it worked before you roll out to the fleet.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — how Conditional Access evaluates and enforces sign-ins, and how it consumes Intune signals.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite, including the all-important break-glass accounts, with verify/implement steps.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps that build every policy in Report-only first, so you see the impact before you enforce.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — device-state discovery, access validation, policy reporting, sign-in analysis, and break-glass verification.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides (including lockout recovery), plus Best Practices.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each one you deploy feels familiar and low-risk — and your team gets faster and more confident with every rollout. Buy once, deploy to unlimited devices, and reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

A strong access baseline — require a compliant device, require MFA, block legacy authentication — rolled out safely with break-glass accounts and Report-only piloting, so only healthy, authenticated users get in and nobody gets locked out.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • CAI-BreakGlassCheck.ps1 — verify emergency-access accounts are excluded from all CA policies
    • CAI-Discovery.ps1 — local device/identity state relevant to Conditional Access
    • CAI-PolicyReport.ps1 — list Conditional Access policies and their state (Microsoft Graph)
    • CAI-SignInReport.ps1 — summarize recent sign-ins and their Conditional Access results (Graph)
    • CAI-Validation.ps1 — confirm this device will satisfy device-based Conditional Access controls

Delivered as a branded Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse across unlimited devices.
